component.name: have-fish
component.summary: Personal finance, kept on your own computer

description.p: A ledger for the money you spend, in every currency you spend it in. Enter transactions by hand or import the CSV your bank exports; have-fish never connects to a bank.

Everything stays in one file on this computer, and exports to an hledger journal whenever you want to take it elsewhere. It opens in your browser, signed in, and asks nothing of the internet unless you turn on exchange-rate lookups.
